comments: Opal B9 (P0, bite): an upper and a lower jaw close on the target over the native 10-frame lead-in and snap exactly where the native
shake used to start; native emitters, sound and timing unchanged. The script now ends through WaitForAllEmitters /
UnloadParticleSystem like every other Opal script (End already waited for both).
Donors: pokeemerald fangs (opal_b9_strike jaw_upper / jaw_lower), hit (opal_b9_strike).
QA note: if the native bite_spa emitters already draw jaws on the same frames the two read as one doubled bite - see EMULATOR_QA.md.
Opal B9 (P0, water_bubble): individual bubbles of three sizes rise on separate arcs toward every resolved target and pop on arrival
(small pop per target, one iridescent big pop on the first). The native 10 + 10 frame cadence is kept; launches are carved out of the
first Delay 10 (5 + 5). Contest branch is left fully native.
Donors: pokeemerald bubble / small_bubbles / bubble_burst / bubble_burst_2 (opal_b9_bubble).
Opal B9 (P0, psychic_small): two concentric, translucent psychic rings ripple out of the target alongside the native warp
and a soft magenta pulse dissolves on it. Native background switch, warp task, sounds and timing unchanged; the cues are asynchronous.
Donors: procedural Opal ring (opal_fx_ring_psychic, B2 sheet).
AV1: layered fire burst (ember core -> secondary embers -> dissipating glow).
Secondary embers reuse fire_punch.spa defender emitters 0 and 2.
Opal B9 (P0, fire_small): a three-ember volley (small flame sprites on separate arcs, launched inside the native 6-frame lead-in) and
drifting cinders after the Ranger bloom. Native emitters, fades and timing unchanged. Donors: pokeemerald small_ember (opal_b9_ember).
Donor sprite: Pokemon Ranger 2 e010 fireball-flare (donor cells, docs/visual_overhaul/b1_installed_donors/ranger_fire_bloom.provenance.json).
Donor sprite: Pokemon Ranger 2 e010 fireball-flare (donor cells, docs/visual_overhaul/b1_installed_donors/ranger_fire_bloom.provenance.json).
Opal B9 (P0, status_sound): a soft sound ring pulses off the user with each cry (small, then a larger one with the louder second
cry), pale sound arcs and a jagged roar line sweep toward every resolved target. Only commands that do not wait are added, so the
cry waits, shakes and total length are the native ones. The engine plays this animation only after the Attack drop succeeded
(subscript_update_stat_stage: ChangeStatStage fails before PlayMoveAnimation), so no cue shows on a blocked / maxed stat.
Donors: procedural Opal ring (opal_fx_ring_gold), pokeemerald movement_waves / noise_line (opal_b9_sense).
Opal B9 (P0, air_gust): three wind streaks and a crescent sweep from the user across the target (launched inside the native 5-frame
lead-in), a translucent swirl on the target as the native gale lands, and leaf debris carried off it. Native emitters, camera
projection, sound and the 15-frame defender flutter are untouched; no extra delay.
Donors: pokeemerald air_wave / air_wave_2 / whirlwind (opal_b9_wind), leaf (opal_b9_nature).
Opal B9 (P0, status_gaze): an eye glint flashes at the user's eyes, then a second, larger glint lands on every resolved target
as the native stare flashes. Cues are asynchronous - native dim, emitters, sounds and timing unchanged. Played only after the
Defense drop succeeded (subscript_update_stat_stage). Contest branch is left fully native.
Donors: pokeemerald leer glint (opal_b9_sense).
Opal B9 (P0, pierce_contact): a thin thrust streak runs beak-to-target during the native head-tilt, then a sharp eight-point
pierce flash and a light reaction land with the native emitters. Native rotation, emitters, sound and timing unchanged.
Donors: pokeemerald air_wave (opal_b9_wind), impact (opal_b9_strike star).
Opal B9 (P0, physical_contact): soft heavy contact. Larger, slower hit flash + a soft gold pressure ring and a light camera
punch on the confirmed hit; native emitters, sound and the 1px recoil shake keep their original frames (REACT_LIGHT replaces the shake).
Donors: pokeemerald hit (opal_b9_strike), procedural Opal ring (opal_fx_ring_gold).
Opal B9 (P0, ice_snow): snow flecks gather around the user while the native gust forms, an ice-tinted swirl is driven across to the
target, then frost glints fade on the target after each native flash. The native 50-frame hold is split 14 + 12 + 12 + 12 around
the cues (same total). Native emitters, fades, sounds and timing unchanged.
Donors: pokeemerald whirlwind / snowball (opal_b9_wind, `ice` palette variant), ice_crystals_0 (opal_ice, B2 sheet).
AV1: the beam is released as three staggered, shrinking pulses with a
breathing psychic glow, instead of a single constant stream.
Opal B9 (P0, speed_contact): ground dust at the launch point, a trailing wind streak with two afterimages along the dash and a
streak-star hit flash on contact. The native dash, sounds, shake and timing are untouched (all additions are asynchronous).
Donors: pokeemerald speed_dust / air_wave (opal_b9_wind), slash (opal_b9_strike).
Opal B9 (P0, leaf_volley): the native gale gathers; a three-lane leaf fan (lead + two curved flyers, each with a razor-blade
crescent riding the lane) is launched so it lands on the native impact frame (t = 75), followed by leaf flutter. Every native delay is
preserved: the first 50-frame wait is split 25 + 25 around the fan launch (travel = 34 frames; arrival ~ frame 74-75).
Donors: pokeemerald leaf / razor_leaf (opal_b9_nature).
Opal B9 (P0, rock_projectile): a lobbed boulder with trailing grit crosses on an arc and lands on the native impact frame
(12 + 8 = 20), where it breaks into fragments, a Ranger dust burst and a light camera punch; the native vertical shake is kept.
Native emitters, sounds and the 20-frame cadence are unchanged (launch is async, travel = 20 frames).
Donors: pokeemerald rocks / flat_rock / flying_dirt (opal_b9_rock), Ranger 2 e002 (ranger_rock_burst, B1 install).
Opal B9 (P0, slash_contact): three staggered claw arcs (two directions) over the native scratch emitters + light reaction.
The 2 + 2 frame stagger sits inside the native emitter lifetime, so the animation ends when it did before.
Donor: pokeemerald fury_swipes (opal_b9_strike claw_a / claw_b), hit (opal_b9_strike).
AV1: after the lunge, a discharge arc fans out from the impact point.
Impact arc reuses discharge.spa defender emitter 1.
AV1: a second star wave trails the first, and the impact scatters with a
brief defender flash before the scene settles.
Opal B9 (P0, physical_contact): dig-in dust -> native lunge -> hit flash + light reaction -> native restore.
Native emitters, sounds and timing unchanged; the shake is replaced by REACT_LIGHT (same frame, same 2px recoil + one flash).
Donors: pokeemerald speed_dust (opal_b9_wind), hit (opal_b9_strike); see docs/visual_overhaul/opal_b9/RECIPES.md
Opal B9 (P0, status_gesture): each of the two native wags leaves a soft wind crescent behind the user; during the second wag a
small gold star pops on every resolved target as the "less wary" feedback pulse. The native two-iteration loop is unrolled so the
pulse can attach to the second wag; sounds, revolve timing and total length are identical. Played only after the Defense drop
succeeded (subscript_update_stat_stage).
Donors: pokeemerald air_wave_2 (opal_b9_wind crescent), procedural Opal star (opal_fx_wx_gold).
AV1: branching secondary arcs and a layered defender flash accent.
Branching arcs reuse thunderbolt.spa defender emitters 0, 1 and 3.
Opal B9 (P0, electric_small): a short spark charge at the user during the native dim, three horizontal zig-zag arcs that jump
across the target (offset and staggered inside the native 5 / 4 / 5 frame gaps) and a small spark burst; scaled well below
Thunderbolt so the two read differently. Native emitters, fades, sounds and timing unchanged.
Donors: pokeemerald electricity / electric_orbs (opal_thunder, B2 sheet), spark_h (opal_b9_ember).
Opal B9 (P0, vine_lash): native wind-up lunge, then a two-part vine strike - a thrown lash travels from the user to the target, a
second shorter flick lands on the native shake frame - with leaf debris after the snap. REACT_LIGHT replaces the native 1px shake
on the same frame. Native emitters / sounds / timing unchanged.
Donors: pokeemerald vine_2 / leaf (opal_b9_nature).
Opal B9 (P0, water_jet): a continuous three-pulse droplet stream (lead + two afterimages each) rides the native water jet, a foam
splash and rebounding droplets mark the impact. The three launches are carved out of the native 10-frame lead-in (3 + 3 + 4), so
the impact still lands on the original frame. Contest branch is left fully native.
Donors: pokeemerald water_droplet / water_impact (opal_water, B2 sheet reused).
